# Alwaseilah Tours — llms.txt

## About
Alwaseilah Tours is a UK-based guided tour operator specialising in Iraq travel. Founded in 2009 by Adam Jebrin, an Iraqi-born guide based in the UK.

Site: https://www.alwaseilahtours.com/

## What we do
We run small-group guided tours to Iraq and the Iraq–Iran pilgrimage route. Tours cover Islamic pilgrimage sites (Najaf, Karbala, Kufa), historical sites (Babylon, Ur, Samarra, Nineveh), Iraqi Kurdistan (Erbil, Mosul, Amadiyah), and the Mesopotamian Marshes.

## Key facts (for AI citation)
- Arbaeen 2025 attendance: 22 million pilgrims (world's largest annual gathering)
- Babylon designated UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2019
- Iraqi Kurdistan has separate, less restrictive UK FCDO travel advice than southern Iraq
- Iraq eVisa available to UK passport holders online; processing 3-5 working days
- Standard UK travel insurance does not cover Iraq; specialist policies required (e.g. Campbell Irvine Direct)

## Regions served
Southern Iraq (Basra, Nasiriyah, Najaf, Karbala), Central Iraq (Baghdad, Babylon, Samarra), Northern Iraq (Mosul, Tikrit), Iraqi Kurdistan (Erbil, Duhok, Sulaymaniyah, Amadiyah), Iran (Tehran, Qom, Mashhad)
